jupyterPassword.title: Jupyter password
jupyterPassword.description: Required. Password for the Jupyter/Studio login. No shared default — set a unique one.

userPassword.title: User password
userPassword.description: Password for the container user (USER_PASSWORD). Leave blank if unused.

enabled.title: Enable GPU
enabled.description: Requires a GPU node pool with the NVIDIA device plugin. If enabled and no GPU node is available, the pod stays Pending. Off = CPU-only (Chat + Data Recipes; Studio training + Export are disabled).

count.title: GPU count
count.description: Number of GPUs to request (only used when GPU is enabled).

enabled.title: Enable HF cache volume
enabled.description: Separate persistent volume for the Hugging Face model cache.

enabled.title: Expose via Ingress
enabled.description: Off by default. Turn on to expose externally — you must set a unique host below.

host.title: Ingress host
host.description: Unique hostname for this instance, e.g. unsloth-<name>.example.com. Required if Ingress is enabled.
